``````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````
1|# ao send
2|
3|Send a message to a running agent session without killing and respawning it.
4|
5|Plain `ao send` delivers a separate message. If a Chat session is busy with a
6|running turn, the message is queued and delivered as its own turn after the
7|current turn ends; it does not reach the running turn. To correct or redirect
8|an agent mid-turn, use `--steer`.
9|
10|## Syntax
11|
12|```
13|ao send [flags]
14|```
15|
16|## Flags
17|
18|| Flag | Meaning | Default / Required |
19||---|---|---|
20|| `--message string` | Message body | Required unless `--recover-only` |
21|| `--session string` | Session id | Required |
22|| `--steer` | Add guidance to the active Chat turn, or start a normal turn when idle | Optional |
23|| `--client-message-id string` | Stable delivery handle for steering and safe retries | Generated automatically with `--steer` |
24|| `--recover-only` | Recover the outcome for an existing delivery handle without resending | Requires `--steer` and `--client-message-id` |
25|
26|## Steering and recovery
27|
28|`--steer` uses one atomic daemon operation. If the session has an active Chat
29|turn, the message is added to that turn. If the session is idle, the message
30|starts a normal Chat turn. The state cannot change between those decisions and
31|leave the message queued as a separate correction.
32|
33|Every steering request has a client message id. Supply one explicitly when a
34|caller must retain the handle across retries:
35|
36|```bash
37|ao send --session mer-3 --steer --client-message-id correction-42 --message "Focus only on the backend."
38|```
39|
40|If the command reports an uncertain outcome or a transport failure, preserve
41|the delivery handle printed in the error. Recover the existing result without
42|contacting the provider again:
43|
44|```bash
45|ao send --session mer-3 --steer --recover-only --client-message-id correction-42
46|```
47|
48|Do not invent a new client message id after an uncertain result. Reusing the
49|original id lets the daemon return the durable steering receipt or normal turn
50|without delivering the message twice. Recovery confirms the recorded delivery
51|outcome, not that the agent acted on the guidance.
52|
53|## Examples
54|
55|```bash
56|# Correct a running agent mid-turn (starts a normal turn if it is idle)
57|ao send --session mer-3 --steer --message "Focus only on the backend; ignore frontend files."
58|```
59|
60|```bash
61|# Give the agent new instructions mid-task
62|ao send --session mer-3 --steer --message "The issue is in session_manager.go line 142, not in the CLI. Investigate there."
63|```
64|
65|```bash
66|# Send a separate message (queued behind a running Chat turn)
67|ao send --session mer-3 --message "When you finish, also update the changelog."
68|```
